description: Run before sending a token. Tokens go to the recipient's token account, not their wallet, and models can't work that address out. Finds the token account (ATA) for a wallet and token with the token's real program, says if it exists, and prices creating it. Example: {"wallet": "<recipient>", "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"} finds where their USDC goes. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/token_account.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

token.description: The token's address. From find_token or tokens. Not a ticker.

wallet.description: The wallet that will own it (usually the recipient). The recipient's wallet address.

name: token_account
